description: This file defines cryptographic hash functions (SHA-1, MD5, SHA-256, SHA-224, SHA-512, SHA-384) within the WPEFramework::Crypto namespace. It includes class declarations, enums for hash types, and method signatures for hashing operations, reset, input, and result retrieval.

classes.name: SHA1
classes.description: Class implementing SHA-1 hashing algorithm with methods for input, reset, and result retrieval.

classes.name: MD5
classes.description: Class implementing MD5 hashing algorithm with methods for input, reset, and result retrieval.

classes.name: SHA256
classes.description: Class implementing SHA-256 hashing algorithm with methods for input, reset, and result retrieval.

classes.name: SHA224
classes.description: Class implementing SHA-224 hashing algorithm, a truncated version of SHA-256.

classes.name: SHA512
classes.description: Class implementing SHA-512 hashing algorithm with methods for input, reset, and result retrieval.

classes.name: SHA384
classes.description: Class implementing SHA-384 hashing algorithm, a truncated version of SHA-512.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the hash object to initial state.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Feeds data into the hash object for processing.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloaded operator to input data into the hash object.

methods.name: CloseContext
methods.description: Finalizes the hash computation, preparing the result.
